guidelines: Use #0B0C0E as main background and #121418 for section cards / elevated blocks.
High contrast red #FF3B30 as primary action trigger (Book Now CTA, submit buttons, primary highlights).
Amber #FF9500 for secondary badges (Phone, Pending Status).
Strict contrast compliance: text on dark surfaces must be #F4F4F6 or #9E9EA9. Never use low contrast gray on dark background.
Never use pure #000000; tint neutrals with cool charcoal/slate hues.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24

items.desc: Precision dent and hail damage removal preserving original factory finish.

items.title: Bumper & Plastic Repair
items.desc: Crack repair, scuff refinishing, and full bumper replacement with factory fitment.

items.title: Scratch & Chip Repair

items.title: Insurance Claims Assistance

components_usage.file_extension_rule: All component files MUST be .jsx (React JavaScript), NEVER .tsx

testing_requirements.rule: ALL interactive elements, form inputs, buttons, navigation links, status indicators, and modal triggers MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.

universal_guidelines: Dark charcoal background with neon-crimson energetic automotive accents.
Large bold headings using Barlow Condensed / Outfit uppercase styles.
Never use generic centered layouts without visual weight.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, or fixed navigation.
Use Sonner for toast feedback on all actions.
Keep source files strictly in JavaScript (.jsx) format.
